inputs.evidence: Mapping with text, lines[{text,confidence,page,box}], supplier, supplier_explicit, invoice_date, totals{total_ht,total_ttc,total_candidate}, rows[{description,cells}], quality_issues
inputs.raw_payload: Model JSON with supplier_name, invoice_date, total_ht, total_ttc, line_items[{description,quantity,unit_price,total_ht}]
inputs.strict_result: Mapping with payload (verified-only JSON) and statuses (path -> status string or {status})

constants.row_line_total_word_guard: reject a numeric row line containing 'total' when fewer than 3 row numbers match
constants.number_parsing: strip spaces/NBSP; both comma and dot: last separator decimal; comma only with 3 trailing digits = thousands; otherwise comma decimal

row_identity: Build row numbers from raw quantity, unit_price, total_ht when non-null.
Find the best description OCR line by min(word coverage, raw/prefix length ratio).
If that line contains at least 2 of the row numbers, it is the row line.
Otherwise choose the evidence line with the most row-number matches; require at least 2.
Reject a chosen numeric line containing 'total' when fewer than 3 row numbers match.
If no row line, the row is not proposed.

description.requires: row line exists; best description line is the same object as the row line; raw description contains every word of the OCR line description prefix and is at least as long

line_numeric.requires: row line exists and the normalized value occurs on that OCR line
line_numeric.total_ht_guard: reject if the value equals any evidence total_ht, total_ttc or total_candidate
line_numeric.quantity_guard: reject quantity if it equals the same row's unit_price

supplier.requires: no documentary supplier contradiction; value matches a documentary line of at most 12 words with no digits, or matches evidence.supplier

date.requires: no documentary date contradiction; ISO date occurs in OCR text as numeric day/month/year, ISO, or month-name form

total_ht: value in total_ttc or total_candidate -> reject ttc_as_ht
value in OCR numbers -> propose missing_label with label_conflict
total_ttc: value in total_candidate -> propose unqualified_total with label_conflict
value in OCR numbers -> propose missing_label with label_conflict

missing_rule.supplier_name: missing_printed if evidence.supplier is non-empty; otherwise absent
missing_rule.invoice_date: missing_printed if evidence.invoice_date is non-empty; otherwise absent
missing_rule.total_ht: missing_printed if evidence.totals.total_ht is non-empty; otherwise absent
missing_rule.total_ttc: missing_printed if evidence.totals.total_ttc or total_candidate is non-empty; otherwise absent
missing_rule.line_fields: missing_printed only when evidence.rows contains that row and the field has a documentary cell/description; otherwise absent
missing_rule.principle: absent is used when documentary evidence cannot establish that a printable value exists; the assessment never asserts a printed value from model output alone

verification_conflict.rule: If strict status is verified and both strict and raw values are non-null and differ, keep status verified, include model_value, set verification_conflict=true and review_required=true.
verification_conflict.effect: The existing verified value is never silently replaced or redefined; the conflict stays visible for diagnostics.

serialization.strict: Return a deep copy of the existing strict payload unchanged. No new keys.
serialization.review: Deep copy existing primary fields, add mode=review_assisted, schema_version=2.1, field_assessments keyed by path, review_summary counts, and verification_conflicts count.
serialization.invariant: Proposed values never appear in primary fields. Field assessments carry status, value/model_value, evidence, reason, checks, review_required, verification_conflict and row identity.

non_goals: No threshold optimization against the six development documents.
No production wiring, API/UI change, flag activation, commit, push or deployment.
No promotion of a proposal to verified because its value appears in OCR text.
No derived value presented as a printed field.
